# Salesmate | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| Listing | AI CRM for SMEs, covering sales, marketing automation and worksheet support. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competition boundaries | Complex business competencies, auditing and customization require Business/Enterprise; Smart Flow, VoIP and SMS are the main incremental costs. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | Business/Enterprise is required for complex enterprise permissions, auditing, and customization; Smart Flow, VoIP, and SMS are the primary incremental costs. |
